structured_output.summary:
Queue backlog: dependency-gated, prioritized admission with `wt queue prioritize` / `wt queue backlog` and a split Active/Backlog list (SPEC-0180).

Admission is now the pure `pick_admissions`, driven by `backlog_readiness`, which re-reads the spec and its `depends_on` in the base checkout. The full pytest suite passes (1487 passed, 1 skipped) and `spec_lint` exits 0. The spec is set to `done` and the ledger regenerated.

ac_status.ac: pick_admissions orders by priority then age, skips not-ready and park-requested items, never exceeds free slots
depends_on gates admission; Y admitted on the first tick after X is done in the base checkout (e2e)
Unknown deps and draft spec keep item in backlog with blocked_by; one backlog event per change
queue add --priority, prioritize (dry-run/--yes, ledger event), backlog --json; invalid priorities error
queue list shows Active and Backlog sections; wt.queue.v1 queued items carry backlog{position,priority,ready,blocked_by}
Full uv run pytest green; spec_lint exits 0

followup_ideas: `wt queue backlog` / `wt queue list` recompute readiness from disk on every call. If the backlog gets long, cache it or only recompute for QUEUED items.

The fake runner's script cursor is per campaign, so multi-campaign e2e tests need a dispatching runner (as in the new dependency e2e). A `campaign`/`spec_id` filter on FakeRunner script entries would make these tests simpler.
